overall_reason: The drag demo moves the 'Draft' file on a 600 ms ease-out, but the file jumps 24 px under the hand when it is picked up, and the grab cursor covers the label it acts on through the whole demo.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY fails twice: the grab point slides at pickup and the cursor covers the words; T-MOTION-SYSTEM passes for the one 600 ms travel curve.

findings.evidence: At capture the travel container sits at x 544 and the file box at x 568, 24 px apart. The sweep's motion_snap passive_shove hit reports 'Draft' jumping +24 px on x at 1426 ms. In the stills the hand sits over the end of 'Draft' at 916 ms and over 'Dr' from 1612 ms on.
findings.before: The file jumps 24 px under the hand at pickup
findings.after: Fix the grab point: give the file and the hand the same offset in one travel container, so the drag is one motion from where the file is
findings.why: A file that jumps when grabbed says the hand slipped; the drag no longer reads as one held object.

findings.evidence: In every still from 405 ms to 5503 ms the hand glyph overlaps the letters of 'Draft' ('Draf', then 'Dr').
findings.before: The cursor covers the label of the thing it drags
findings.after: Grab the file by its icon or its edge so the label stays readable through the drag
findings.why: The viewer cannot read what is being moved while it moves.

strengths: The file travels on one 600 ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) ease-out with a box-shadow that answers in 160 ms, and it lands and holds at its new place from 2602 ms.
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
